clauses.note: Students are reminded of existing behavioral norms (move safely, make space) but do not actively develop or co-create group norms; norms are teacher-imposed reminders, not student-developed. However, students are directed to follow norms (thumbs-up readiness, designated spots, cleanup routines), which is thin participation in norm-following rather than norm-developing — partial at best.

clauses.note: Students discuss texts via total participation techniques and turn-and-talk, responding to questions about the read-aloud texts (Summer Sun Risin' and the song), demonstrating text discussion.

Listen to others as they share their writing
Offer feedback on peers' writing
Respond to feedback received on own writing

verdicts.evidence: As needed, remind them to move safely and make space for everyone.
verdicts.rationale: The resource partially meets 1.P.EICC.1.e. The "discuss texts" clause is met: students engage in total participation techniques and turn-and-talk discussions about the read-aloud texts, e.g., "'What is the setting of a story?' (when and where a story takes place)" and "'What are some hand gestures, motions, or actions that could go along with these nouns and verbs in the song?'" The "develop group norms" clause is only partially met — students are reminded of norms ("move safely and make space for everyone") and follow established routines (thumbs-up readiness, cleanup signals), but they do not actively develop or co-create norms. The remaining four clauses — share individual writing, listen as others share writing, offer feedback, and respond to feedback — are not met. Students complete a response sheet independently, but it is collected by the teacher with no sharing, listening, or feedback cycle.
